methodology.tost_delta_derivation: 5% of |mean(Phase 2 PPH)| filtered to 32 legitimate factorial cells (RUN-P2-C*-S* pattern, val_ppl < 100)
methodology.n_seeds_note: Phase 3 executed with n=1 per method; TOST results are point estimates, no bootstrap CIs computed. Spec §10.3.1 anticipated n=5.

FFT_vs_QLoRA.option1_note: Under V2 per-method baseline, QLoRA's PPH includes wrapping-pathway penalty as apparent improvement
FFT_vs_QLoRA.option2_note: Under V3 common baseline, direct-eval commensurability removes wrapping artifact

conclusions.quality_note: FFT wins all 5 language tracks with substantial margins (3-13 PPL)
conclusions.fft_vs_cpt_note: Formally declared compute-efficiency equivalent by TOST under both baseline conventions and robust across sensitivity δ
conclusions.qlora_vs_others_pph: Convention-dependent; cannot claim unambiguous PPH ranking for QLoRA
conclusions.qlora_vs_others_note: The ~5,600 PPL wrapping-pathway penalty in QLoRA's V2 baseline flips the PPH verdict
conclusions.recommendation_reasoning: Best raw quality unambiguously, equivalent efficiency to CPT, cost-competitive with CPT, avoids the QLoRA baseline-interpretation ambiguity

compliance_disclosures.n_seeds_phase3: Single seed per method; spec §10.3.1 anticipated n=5; documented in Chapter 6 as limitation
compliance_disclosures.baseline_convention: Two conventions reported for transparency; conclusions differ where noted
